svg.title: RoPE rotates Q and K using the position
svg.desc: A toy split-half coordinate pair at indices 0 and 2 rotates at position 2 with angle 2 radians. Qwen pairs the first and second halves rather than neighboring coordinates. The displayed pair before and after comes from the deterministic toy. V is unchanged.

g.text: Toy position 2, pair (q₀,q₂), angle φ = 2 radians
q′₀ = q₀ cos φ − q₂ sin φ
q′₂ = q₂ cos φ + q₀ sin φ
q_rot = q*cos + rotate_half(q)*sin; same rule for k
Q/K shape stays unchanged. V carries values without this rotation.
